change: Bounded lexical retrieval and candidate verification
notes: Rare lexical tokens and Unicode character trigrams retrieve candidate locations before expensive similarity verification.
Previous and next Markdown blocks vote directionally for the expected target block, preserving moved-and-rewritten anchors.
Candidate indexes use implementation-neutral arrays, maps, strings, and deterministic sorting suitable for browser, CLI, JavaScript, and Python ports.
The fuzzy index is built lazily and shared per document so exact and structural matches do not pay its construction cost.
Timing is informational and is not used as a deterministic regression gate.
